title: Immigration Processes with Binomial Catastrophes and Random Survival Parameters
summary: We consider immigration processes with binomial catastrophes and random survival parameters. Two sources of randomness are analyzed. In the first model, the survival parameter is independently resampled at each catastrophe. In the second model, individuals are assigned independent survival parameters at birth, which remain fixed over time. We show that the first model exhibits almost sure extinction, as in the classical case with a fixed survival parameter.
